children: Shoe Station Group Inc reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $284.3M and diluted EPS of $0.23, as sales and earnings declined versus the year-ago quarter amid weaker comps and margin pressure from promotions on aged inventory.
Revenue: $284.3M for Q2 2026, down from $306.4M in Q2 2025 ( (7.2%) ).
Net income: $6.3M for Q2 2026, down from $19.2M in Q2 2025 ( (67.5%) ).
Diluted earnings per share: $0.23 for Q2 2026, down from $0.70 in Q2 2025 ( (67.1%) ).
Revenue trend: Net sales declined roughly 7% in Q2 and about 5% year-to-date, driven by a ~4% drop in units and weaker comparable-store sales.
Channel shift: E-commerce grew to about 10% of merchandise sales (from 8–9%), reflecting an ongoing omnichannel mix shift.
Brand performance: Both Shoe Carnival and Shoe Station saw comps decline (Carnival ~6–8%, Station ~8–9%), with assortments noted as misaligned with customer preferences.
Operational changes: The company converted 21 stores to Shoe Station year-to-date, closed 4 stores and plans 8–10 additional closures in FY26 plus 6–10 in FY27.
Inventory and margin impact: Inventory was down ~5% year-over-year; the company sold aged and pre-tariff inventory via promotions, which materially reduced gross margin.
